title: The Glasshouse of Milton Flats
author: Lena Okonkwo
blurb: Paloma Dunmore, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has spent five years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
